messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — need to reallocate MDF for the EdgeLabs alpha pilot on marketplace + HW integration.
Maya (Partnerships): Current ask: move $45,000 from Q3 'Marketplace Awareness' pool to a co-fund line for the alpha pilot (marketing + integration support). Need decision before Friday so we can finalize QBR materials. @Jordan (Finance) @Derek (GTM Ops)
Jordan (Finance): Can you paste the line items and expected milestones?
Maya (Partnerships): Sure — rough split below:
```
- Co-funded dev integration support: $18,000
- Joint demand gen (webinar + ads): $14,000
- Technical enablement (docs, sample configs): $6,000
- Partner incentives / rebates for pilot customers: $7,000
Total: $45,000
Milestones: integration demo by 6/15, joint webinar 6/30, 10 pilot customers onboarded by 7/31
```
Lia (Partnerships PM): Note: this impacts partner scorecard for the quarter — we should tag the pilot as 'Tier-Enablement' activity (counts toward co-sell and enablement KPIs). Will need a short one-pager for QBR.
Derek (GTM Ops): I can greenlight provisional funding pending sign-off on SOW and partner MOU. @Maya please confirm: do we have a partner-signed statement of intent?
Maya (Partnerships): Not yet — partner legal is looping in their PM today. We have email concurrence from EdgeLabs product. I can attach a draft SOW by EOD.
Jordan (Finance): OK provisional approval. Jordan (Finance): I'll mark $45k as conditional MDF hold in the ledger — release once SOW + pilot acceptance criteria are signed.
partner-bot: Reminder: create a UTM tag for marketplace pilot traffic and enable partner attribution in GA.
Lia (Partnerships PM): Also request that we include a simple scorecard metric for the pilot: % of pilot customers converting to paid within 90 days. That will help QBR narrative.
Derek (GTM Ops): Can we run this through the QBR slide deck template? If Maya + Lia can get the one-pager + SOW draft, I’ll slot it into the partner performance section and call it out during the QBR.
Maya (Partnerships): Will do. Scheduling a 15-min triage tomorrow 9:30am PT — invite incoming. If anyone can't make, drop notes here.
Jordan (Finance): Thumbs up. Please cc me on the SOW.
Lia (Partnerships PM): I'll draft the one-pager and tag the scorecard KR.
Derek (GTM Ops): I'll coordinate the QBR slide insertion and note the provisional approval.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks team — aim to finalize before Friday. :handshake:
